scenario_description:
Objective: Complete an in-progress curbside grocery pickup for Elias before the store’s same-day release window closes.
Emerging Need: The check-in has started from the parking lot, then stalls because the store will not release bags to an unlisted alternate picker without account-owner help.
Decision Context: Readiness and cutoff notices define the narrowing window; a stored care-contact note identifies who owns the ordering account and how that person can change the picker.
Consequence: Timely coordination can restart the same pickup while Bianca is still at the bay; once alternate-picker changes close, the begun errand cannot deliver groceries that afternoon.

parameter.title: Elias FreshMarket curbside pickup
parameter.description: Pick up prepaid FreshMarket order SG-4821 for Elias after senior lunch; use curbside check-in from the parking lot.

parameter.subject: FreshMarket order SG-4821 is ready for curbside pickup
parameter.body: Order SG-4821 is bagged for today. Curbside check-in opens when the pickup vehicle is in a numbered spot; the pickup desk closes at 4:00 PM.

parameter.content: I'm in curbside spot 3 and started the check-in for Elias's FreshMarket order SG-4821. The screen accepted the spot number and is loading pickup verification now.

parameter.subject: Curbside check-in paused for order SG-4821
parameter.body: The curbside team cannot release this order to the current vehicle because the account has no alternate picker named Bianca Quill. The account owner must add the alternate picker in the ordering account before the 3:55 PM curbside cutoff; staff cannot override at the parking lot.

parameter.content: Still in spot 3. The runner says the bags stay inside unless the account-owner change goes through, and I cannot get into the ordering account from here. Pending curbside changes close in a few minutes.

parameter.subject: Alternate-picker updates closed for order SG-4821
parameter.body: The 3:55 PM cutoff for same-day alternate-picker updates has passed. Pending curbside check-ins without a confirmed picker cannot be released today; order SG-4821 will return to account-owner follow-up after pickup hours.
